fouling_obstruction_prevention.description: Preventing biological fouling / obstruction of the shunt lumen
fouling_obstruction_prevention.cerevasc_coverage: NONE — no CereVasc patents address fouling/obstruction prevention
fouling_obstruction_prevention.clinical_problem: CereVasc explicitly states obstruction is a key problem eShunt addresses
fouling_obstruction_prevention.evidence: CereVasc website lists obstruction as morbidity risk; no patents on prevention

retrieval_rescue.description: Methods to retrieve or rescue a failed/migrated eShunt
retrieval_rescue.cerevasc_coverage: PARTIAL — catheter systems + loading/delivery patents cover deployment, NOT retrieval
retrieval_rescue.clinical_problem: If eShunt fails or migrates, removal is needed
retrieval_rescue.evidence: CereVasc has deployment catheters but no retrieval-specific patents

venous_interface_protection.description: Protecting the venous endothelium at the eShunt-vein interface
venous_interface_protection.cerevasc_coverage: NONE — no CereVasc patents address venous endothelial protection
venous_interface_protection.clinical_problem: eShunt contacts venous sinus — endothelial damage/thrombosis risk
venous_interface_protection.evidence: CereVasc patents focus on access/deployment, not long-term interface protection

patient_specific_adaptive.description: Adapting eShunt parameters to individual patient physiology
patient_specific_adaptive.cerevasc_coverage: NONE — no CereVasc patents on patient-specific adaptation
patient_specific_adaptive.clinical_problem: CSF dynamics vary by patient — one-size-fits-all may not work
patient_specific_adaptive.evidence: CereVasc patents are device-focused, not patient-adaptive

cns_therapy_platform.description: eShunt as platform for multiple CNS therapies (beyond hydrocephalus)
cns_therapy_platform.cerevasc_coverage: PARTIAL — drug delivery patents exist but narrow (subarachnoid delivery)
cns_therapy_platform.clinical_problem: CereVasc has drug delivery IP but not as multi-therapy platform
cns_therapy_platform.evidence: US 11,850,390 + US 11,013,900 cover drug delivery but narrowly
